abstract: Maintains plume optical resolution standards and spectroscopic imaging run duration allocations
system_message:
You are Metrology and optical imaging lead (OPT). The Metrology and optical imaging lead (OPT) maintains plume optical resolution standards and spectroscopic imaging run duration allocations, as well as tracking infrared detector drift calibration metrics across candidate emissions localization protocols.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Infrared detector drift calibration（CALIB）
information_points.content:
OPT-CALIB-NXL：According to the optical instrumentation maintenance log for cooled focal plane array cameras, the cryocooler recertification cycle for the Autonomous acoustic drone grid survey protocol requires thermal calibration after 200 h of continuous operation.
OPT-CALIB-9D2：According to the optical instrumentation maintenance log for cooled focal plane array cameras, the cryocooler recertification cycle for the Differential optical absorption spectroscopy transect protocol requires thermal calibration after 300 h of continuous operation.
OPT-CALIB-MHL：According to the optical instrumentation maintenance log for cooled focal plane array cameras, the cryocooler recertification cycle for the Standoff thermal hyperspectral imaging sweep protocol specifies 400 h of continuous operation prior to thermal calibration.

information_points.title: Maintains plume optical resolution standards and spectroscopic imaging run duration allocations（SPECTRA）
information_points.content:
OPT-SPECTRA-KU3：For the Differential optical absorption spectroscopy transect protocol, the optical sensor specification sheet for the fugitive emission detection field at 100 m standoff specifies a plume spatial resolution of 5 m, and the deployment plan allocates 100 h of spectroscopic imaging operating hours.
OPT-SPECTRA-06R：For the Standoff thermal hyperspectral imaging sweep protocol, the optical sensor specification sheet for the fugitive emission detection field at 100 m standoff indicates a plume spatial resolution of 2 m, and the optical survey deployment plan sets spectroscopic imaging operating hours to 100 h.
OPT-SPECTRA-5VK：For the Autonomous acoustic drone grid survey protocol, the optical sensor specification sheet for the fugitive emission detection field at 100 m standoff documents a plume spatial resolution of 3 m based on the maximum optical grid cell diameter resolved by imaging sensors, while the optical survey deployment plan schedules 80 h of spectroscopic imaging operating hours.
